 Community News Pasadena Braces for Rainy Thursday as Early-Season Storm Arrives Overnight
 NATIONAL WEATHER SERVICE Published on Wednesday, November 18, 2026 | 4:56 am 
 Pasadena residents can expect the first significant storm of the season to arrive overnight Wednesday and continue through Thursday, bringing widespread rain, gusty winds and a chance of thunderstorms, according to the National Weather Service. 
 Forecasters said increasing clouds Wednesday will give way to rain after 10:00 p.m., with the heaviest precipitation expected Thursday. Rainfall totals in Pasadena could range from three-quarters of an inch to 1 inch, while temperatures remain well below seasonal averages through the weekend. 
 Wednesday is expected to remain mostly dry, with a high near 66 degrees. Light east winds will shift to the south and southwest during the afternoon as the storm system approaches. 
 A 30% chance of rain begins Wednesday night after 10:00 p.m. under mostly cloudy skies. Overnight temperatures will fall to around 52 degrees with southeast winds of 5 to 10 mph. New rainfall amounts between one-quarter and one-half inch are possible before daybreak Thursday. 
 The storm’s most active period is forecast Thursday, when rain is expected throughout the day. The National Weather Service forecasts a 100% chance of precipitation, with rain and a possible thunderstorm before 4:00 p.m. Additional rainfall amounts between three-quarters of an inch and 1 inch are possible. 
 Forecasters said a moderate to strong low-pressure system moving into California will bring widespread rain, gusty winds, mountain snow and isolated thunderstorms across Southern California. The agency warned of possible flooding impacts from periods of heavy rain. 
 Temperatures will cool further Thursday, with a high near 62 degrees. Winds will shift from the south at about 10 mph before turning west-southwest during the afternoon. Gusts could reach 15 mph. 
 Conditions are expected to improve Thursday night as rain diminishes. Only a 20% chance of lingering showers remains before 10:00 p.m. Skies will gradually clear, with overnight lows around 45 degrees. 
 Dry weather returns Friday with sunny skies and a high near 63 degrees. Friday night will be mostly clear, with temperatures dropping to around 43 degrees. 
 The weekend forecast calls for continued dry conditions and cool temperatures. Saturday will be mostly sunny with a high near 63 degrees, while Sunday will be sunny with a high near 62 degrees. A slight chance of rain returns Sunday night. 
 Looking ahead, Monday is expected to remain sunny with a high near 63 degrees. Temperatures will slowly moderate, reaching about 66 degrees Tuesday under mostly sunny skies. 
 Pasadena residents should prepare for wet roadways and potentially hazardous driving conditions Thursday, especially during periods of heavier rain. The National Weather Service also noted the possibility of localized flooding as the storm moves through the region. 
 Here is the Pasadena forecast from the National Weather Service as of 3:12 a.m. Wednesday: 
 Today: Increasing clouds, with a high near 66. East wind around 5 mph becoming south southwest in the afternoon. 
 Tonight: A 30 percent chance of rain after 10:00 p.m. Mostly cloudy, with a low around 52. Southeast wind 5 to 10 mph. New precipitation amounts between a quarter and half of an inch possible. 
 Thursday: Rain and possibly a thunderstorm before 4pm, then a slight chance of rain and thunderstorms after 4:00 p.m. High near 62. South wind around 10 mph becoming west southwest in the afternoon. Winds could gust as high as 15 mph. Chance of precipitation is 100%. New rainfall amounts between three quarters and one inch possible. 
 Thursday Night: A 20 percent chance of rain before 10:00 p.m. Mostly clear, with a low around 45. West wind around 5 mph becoming north after midnight. 
 Friday: Sunny, with a high near 63. North northwest wind around 5 mph becoming west in the morning. 
 Friday Night: Mostly clear, with a low around 43. 
 Saturday: Mostly sunny, with a high near 63. 
 Saturday Night: Mostly clear, with a low around 47. 
 Sunday: Sunny, with a high near 62. 
 Sunday Night: A slight chance of rain. Partly cloudy, with a low around 47. 
 Monday: Sunny, with a high near 63. 
 Monday Night: Mostly clear, with a low around 49. 
 Tuesday: Mostly sunny, with a high near 66.
